hackathons.name: MediMitra
hackathons.description: Public health chatbot delivering disease awareness and outbreak alerts via low-bandwidth WhatsApp & SMS using an n8n RAG pipeline.
hackathons.challenge: Public health awareness in rural communities limited by low internet bandwidth and lack of medical app adoption.
hackathons.role: Team Lead & AI Architect — designed the n8n RAG workflow and multilingual Gemini NLU pipeline.
hackathons.outcome: Selected among Top 30 college finalists for Smart India Hackathon software-track submission.

hackathons.name: Analytrix '26 Datathon
hackathons.description: End-to-end data cleaning, validation pipeline, and executive dashboarding for noisy real-world datasets.
hackathons.challenge: Filtering raw unstructured data for accuracy under strict time and validation constraints.
hackathons.role: Data Pipeline & Visualization Lead — performed Python/Pandas cleaning and Power BI modeling.
hackathons.outcome: High-signal Power BI & Python dashboards surfacing reliable operational insights.

hackathons.name: Edith – AI Agent Buildathon
hackathons.description: Telegram-integrated AI agent enabling local kirana convenience stores to manage inventory and supplier orders through conversational chat.
hackathons.challenge: Kirana store owners struggle with complex inventory dashboards and manual order tracking.
hackathons.role: Full-Stack AI Engineer — integrated Telegram Bot API with n8n workflow automation.
hackathons.outcome: Fully functioning Telegram bot processing real-time stock queries and automating supplier reorders.

awards.title: Smart India Hackathon Software Finalist
awards.description: Recognized as a top 30 team nationally at SIH 2025 for MediMitra.

research.title: Applied AI in Grassroots Agriculture
research.description: Developing local forecasting architectures utilizing ARIMA and historical AGMARKNET government crop data.
